A great little bmx game, very similar to the trials series but also reminds me a lot of OlliOlli.
The game's campaign can be completed in roughly 10 hours (depending on how good you are at these types of games) and provides plenty more replayability through online leaderboards. The physics feel good and the flow of the levels feels very satisfying once you get the proper pushing and boosting down too.

Following the $1/hr of playtime rule, this game is definitely fairly priced and provides tons of fun for biking game enthusiasts. The game will go on sale for 90% at times though, which is definitely a tempting discount. If you're unsure if this kind of game is for you, it's still worth it to pick up on a sale just to try.

A little note for achievement hunters: 

maybe just consider this game 100%ed once you complete every level goal the campaign has to offer. Beyond that there's nothing more than milestone achievements like doing said trick so many times or completing so many runs, usually a number you'll never achieve through regular play, and as far as I witnessed some of these achievements don't even get tracked properly (for me it was the aitken challenge specifically). 

The pro achievements are fun though, although I wish the devs would make these challenges apparent in the game's UI as well, maybe lock them to a specific level and add the achievement requirements to the goal list (didn't enjoy scouting for levels until finding one where the challenge is doable at all personally).

Overall a very solid game and definitely worth the price.

Trials Fusion on a BMX bicycle and a heckload of tricks and combos to fry your brain on.

The instructions and tutorials are minimal and not telling you much about the game. You generally have two sets of tricks, most of which are being performed by pressing a combination of the 'WASD' key set. Naturally you have to accelerate before each jump and to hit accelerate while on air after you performed the on air trick.... why????

Being a BMX fan in my youth (in the 80's) I wanted to really love this one, yet the controls and combos of the keys totally killed the game for me, or (and most probably), I'm just an old bastard who claims to be a gamer without having the actual skills.
